summary: This resolution sets procedural rules for House floor consideration of five bills amending ERISA and the Fair Labor Standards Act on retirement factors, work hours, overtime calculations, tipped employees, and joint-employer status, by waiving points of order, adopting committee substitutes, limiting debate to one hour per bill, and allowing one motion to recommit.

The resolution makes in order five bills that amend ERISA and the FLSA. H.R. 4366 narrows joint-employer liability under the NLRA and FLSA, H.R. 2312 revises the tipped-employee definition, and the remaining measures adjust overtime calculations and hours-worked definitions. Collectively these changes increase employer flexibility and limit the reach of existing worker protections and union leverage. The procedural vehicle therefore facilitates policy movement in the pro-employer direction on labor issues.
